clues: This town is a border town in the south-west of its land, where two rivers meet. A town of the land next door stares back from the far bank.
Winters here are odd: the cold comes and goes, and the air hangs near the freeze point. Summers are warm, fed by the inland spot.
In June 1941 the fort of this town held out in a famed stand. Its land later named the fort a Hero Fort for that stand.
This is one of the most old towns in its land. Two great pacts of the past bear its name in their titles.
This town is the chief town of its region and its district. Yet in rule it stands apart from the district round it.
